We should take all the best ideas for laws collection, and fully automate it, prepare scripts to load all laws in all government supported languages, we should do so for laws of USA, Europe, China, India, Russia, Georgia.

We also should try to make a copy of Formal AI, so it will be able to formalize all laws into meta-language (also copied here if needed).

We copy not fork, as we need to do it fast, later we will incorporate the experience back.

We also generate lots of tests, to make sure we do it perfectly and actually working, it should be precise and free of LLMs.

We must produce library for all kind of scripts (data processing, tests, and assistant itself), CLI, API server, Docker with API server, and GitHub WebPages demo, which should fully work using only data we collected.

We should prepare everything we need and do some test temporary collection and build tests up on it. Later we will do permanent data collection (if legal to distribute to not overload government services) in separate repository, it will run by schedule, so all updates will come to repository once a week or other configurable period.

We should use as much of associative tech stack of https://raw.githubusercontent.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/refs/heads/main/docs/associative-tech-stack.md (check also other our projects in our organization repository), but only in JavaScript.

So we can prototype and iterate fast.

For dependencies if something is wrong or missing you report issues, but that should not stop you, you can make temporary copies of them with patches (only patches are storable in repository not full copies), so we can iterate fast and later apply these patches back, so we can just update to latest versions after that.

It is also ok to use specific commits of still in development latest pull requests, so patches are minimized.

So we make tools to collect data, formalize it as much as possible, preferably into meta language, and modify code of Formal AI by patches in such a way, so it is capable of answering virtually any legal question based on actual laws data.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Make a demo of legal assistant based on Formal AI and automated data collection
